kit_properties: Every number in every draft matches the Fact Sheet or a story's own numbers.
No draft names a person whose story marks them as not to be named.
No sentence uses any of these words: passionate, journey, leverage, synergy, rockstar, I led, impactful, game-changing.

The goals essay names the short-term goal specifically: A product manager on a health-data team at a large technology company or a health-system software company, in the US or India, owning a clinical workflow rather than an internal tool.
The leadership essay leads with "The night-shift fix", or the Strategist says why another story is stronger.
The setback essay leads with "The migration I got wrong", or the Strategist says why another story is stronger.
